Pulse for 31 October 2026

The stories from 31 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Everyday tool

Hidden mark on Claude text

A text watermark is a hidden pattern in which words a model chooses, and Anthropic says four older Claude models will start carrying that pattern on 3 November 2026.

Everyday tool

ChatGPT will count tokens

A token is a small unit of information a model processes and generates, and from December the Plus, Pro, and Business plans will spend one shared allowance of them across ChatGPT and Codex.

Everyday tool

AI drafts the permit report

PlanAssist is a checking tool, built with Gemini for English councils, that reads routine home-building paperwork and drafts a cited report a planning officer can still edit.

AI agents

It can help before you ask

A coding agent is a program that can carry out a software task, and DeepSeek has published a research prototype that may watch a team channel and step in only when someone asks or a written rule allows it.
